text:
sasha: Quick heads-up — onboarding mira-13b. The model manifest's weight_uri is `gs://purple-bucket/mira/weights/step-1000.pt` but our serve pipeline expects an s3 URI. Also tokenizer.json from HF dropped `pad_token_id` (null). Config validator failed in CI. Anyone able to do a quick triage? :eyes:
kevin: I can take the weight_uri swap. Which s3 bucket should we use?
sasha: Use `s3://redwood-models/mira/2026-02-14/weights.pt` — that's the canonical staging path. I'll update the manifest once we confirm.
nana: small note — HF tokenizer had added_tokens that shift ids by +1; we saw sample inference where generation truncates early. Setting `pad_token_id` back to 0 worked in local smoke.
morgan: @kevin I pushed a tiny PR for the URI replace and added a comment about fingerprinting. pinged you in the PR for review. :thumbsup:
ci-validator: schema check failed:
```
- missing required field: "metadata.version"
- tokenizer.pad_token_id: null (expected integer)
- weight_uri: scheme mismatch (expected s3:// or http(s)://)
```
chris: For immediate unblocking, set `tokenizer.pad_token_id` explicitly in model_config.json and re-run `tools/validators/config-lint --target mira-13b`. I'll approve the URI change after CI passes.
kevin: copying local patch here for the replace command: `sed -E 's|gs://purple-bucket|s3://redwood-models/mira/2026-02-14|' manifest.json > manifest.fixed.json` — then upload manifest.fixed.json to the onboarding bucket.
sasha: perfect. I'm adding "metadata.version": "2026-02-14" and "tokenizer.pad_token_id": 0 in the same PR so CI only needs one run. Leaving a note about the HF added_tokens in the PR description.
morgan: quick QA tip — run `python infra/scripts/tokenizer_check.py --model mira-13b --sample 'Hello world'` to confirm no id shifts. Saved me once.
chris: once CI green, I'll trigger the dedicated serve smoke job. If we still see token mismatch, we can fallback to the earlier tokenizer artifact (tokenizer-v1) by setting `tokenizer_alias` in the config.
kevin: on it now, will update PR and mark for review.
sasha: thanks everyone — tagging `@chris` to watch the smoke job. We'll close this thread after deploy smoke passes. :rocket:
